name: ALERT
intro: ALERT 是一个与模型无关的推荐解释评估基准，包含 Amazon Reviews 2023 的 15 个电商类别、2,761 个用户–商品交互，以最近购买为目标商品、此前购买为隐式偏好画像。每轮评测固定采用 ALERT-Gen 或 ALERT-Disc 覆盖全部四项准则，分别判断后多数投票，最终报告候选解释相对 PreferenceLogic 的胜率。
org: Worcester Polytechnic Institute, Amazon.com, Northwestern University, University of Notre Dame, Univ
build_method: Amazon购买记录筛选、购买历史画像、编辑团队与用户研究准则设计
intro_en: ALERT is a model-agnostic recommendation-explanation benchmark with 2,761 user-item interactions from 15 Amazon Reviews 2023 categories. It treats the latest purchase as the target item and earlier purchases as an implicit-preference profile. Each evaluation run fixes either ALERT-Gen or ALERT-Disc across all four criteria, judges them separately, majority-votes the preferences, and reports candidate win rate against PreferenceLogic.
metric_en: Win rate against the PreferenceLogic baseline
drawio_review_note: CORRECTED against ACL Anthology 2025.naacl-long.137 §§3.1–3.2, §§4.2–4.4, Appendix A, and Appendix B.2. The main lane follows Figure 3 and §3.2.2 exactly: divide the four criteria into individual components, use one evaluator variant—ALERT-Gen or ALERT-Disc—consistently across all four criteria, then aggregate the four preferences by majority vote before computing win rate. The release excludes sensitive demographics and does not publish user IDs. The meta-evaluation lane keeps §4.2 controlled data/prompt interruption tests parallel to the separate §4.3 expert-correlation study; only the latter uses 88 explanation pairs and three professional annotators and leads to no-tie accuracies of 0.667 for ALERT-Gen and 0.711 for ALERT-Disc. The paper-linked official repository URL https://github.com/bigheiniu/ALERT-LLMRecomBenchmark currently returns 404, so no repository revision is claimed.
